description: This header file defines interfaces and includes dependencies for a cryptography utility, supporting multiple crypto libraries (MbedTLS, OpenSSL, WolfSSL). It declares data types, function prototypes for cipher operations, context management, and cryptographic buffer handling.

methods.name: hexstr2buf
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a buffer. Its implementation varies depending on the cryptography library used (MbedTLS or OpenSSL/WolfSSL).

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Fetches a cipher by name, printing an error if not found.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Returns the IV size for a given cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Returns the key size for a given cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a crypto context for encryption or decryption.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on input and output files based on the provided context.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees and cleans up a cryptographic context.
